reason: The hypothesis combines the well-known protective role of the native oxide film at room temperature (from P1, P4, P7) with the finding that elevated temperature enhances passivation in alkaline solutions (P9, P21, P23, P30) to propose a novel, opposite effect in harsh saline environments: thermal degradation of the film. This synthesis of two separate bodies of evidence into a single mechanistic prediction about temperature-dependent film breakdown is not stated in any passage.
